title: Temari atomic scattering factor table (dataset-factors, schema_version 2)
description: One file per chemical species: X-ray atomic scattering factor f_x(s) [electrons] and the first-Born electron scattering factor f_e(s) [A] on the fixed grid s_i = 6 i / 7680 (7681 nodes, NOT stored - reconstruct it and check s_grid.sha256_f64le). Version 2 adds charged species. f_e splits into a closed-form monopole and a tabulated regular part: f_e(s) = monopole_coefficient_A_inv / s^2 + f_e_regular_A(s). The monopole is NEVER tabulated (sampling 1/s^2 breaks down as s -> 0), and the regular part must NEVER be rebuilt by subtracting the monopole from f_e (both diverge at low s and the difference loses its digits). For a neutral species the coefficient is exactly zero and f_e_regular_A equals f_e_A at every node. For a charged species f_e_A[0] is null (f_e diverges as K^-2 at s = 0) while f_e_regular_A stays finite. A species is identified by occupation_nlq in canonical form (sorted by (n,l), zero occupancies dropped), whose hash is configuration_sha256: charge alone does not identify it, since 3d6 and 3d5-4s1 share a charge. Read the interpolation_contract: f_x is a cubic spline in s with f_x'(0) = 0 at the left end and not-a-knot at the right end; f_e_regular_A uses the same t = s^2 not-a-knot rule the neutral f_e used. Values are decimal-rounded to 11 significant digits and serialized as JSON numbers; loaders parse them as binary64 and do not re-round. gamma (incident-electron relativistic factor) is NOT included in f_e. This schema is normative for schema_version 2.

dataset_version.description: Semantic version of the DATA (dataset-factors family), independent of the software version and of the F(s,E0) dataset. '0.0.0-dev' means a prescription or grid outside the shipping contract and MUST NOT be packed for release.

artifact_role.description: Which loader entry point may read this table. From the 2026-09-14 generation onward every shipping table is 'computed' (author decisions I35 / I36: the stopping-error bound claim was withdrawn, so no table carries a certified error bound), and the ordinary entry point reads a table only when it belongs to a release listed in the loader's trusted release registry (author decision I43), never on the strength of this field alone. 'certified' stays in the enum only for tables generated before 2026-09-14 (ion v0.3.0 / v0.4.0); a current loader does not treat that self-declaration as certification. 'control' is a comparison artifact (e.g. the point-nucleus B set) that the ordinary entry point must refuse. REQUIRED from schema v2 onward, rather than defaulted, so that a v2 file cannot claim a role silently. Schema v1 files predate the field, and a current loader does not read a v1 file as certified either.

certification_status_reason.description: Why the table has the certification_status it has (from the 2026-09-14 generation onward). For 'not_certified' it states that the stopping-error bound claim was withdrawn (author decision I34, 2026-09-13) and that no table carries a certified error bound.

certification_history.description: Provenance of the earlier classification of this species (from the 2026-09-14 generation onward), or null for a table outside both shipping families. classification is the value the machine-readable record assigned after a post-hoc reanalysis with supplementary measurements and rule changes (author decision I37); raw_status is the verdict in the run record before any author override, and override names the author decision that changed it. It is kept for provenance and is NOT a certification: a consumer must not read classification = 'certified' as a current guarantee.

certification_status.description: The CURRENT certification state of this table. From the 2026-09-14 generation onward every shipping table has 'not_certified' together with certification_status_reason and certification_history (author decisions I35 / I36); the classification an earlier post-hoc reanalysis returned (certified, uncertifiable_low_signal, ...) is kept in certification_history.classification as provenance and is not a certification. The other values appear only in tables generated from 2026-09-12 to 2026-09-13 (author decision I12): there the field was the classification the pre-registered grid/stopping/box certification returned, 'certified' was the only value that could accompany artifact_role = 'certified', and every other value meant the registered proof could not decide for that species (NOT a statement that the numbers are wrong). 'not_a_shipping_species' marks a table that is outside both shipping families. Schema v2 files generated before 2026-09-12 predate the field; a reader that finds artifact_role = 'certified' without this field must refuse it.

certification_record_sha256.description: sha256 of the machine-readable certification record (src/certification_status.json in the source repository) that decided artifact_role and certification_status for this table. REQUIRED from the 2026-09-12 generation onward. A consumer that has the record must compare this digest with it: the field names the evidence, and naming it is not the same as being bound to it.

model_id.description: Physics + numerics identifier. Every file in a set carries the same value; a set with mixed model_id is not a dataset.

generator_commit.description: Full git SHA of the generator source tree (pure hash; dirtiness is a separate field).

source_dirty.description: true if src/ had uncommitted (tracked or untracked) changes at generation time. Shipping files MUST have false.

generator_source_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the include closure of the generator (CRLF normalized to LF), the real identity of the code that ran. Uniform across a set and equal to the value frozen in manifest.json.

charge.description: q_net = Z - N, the net charge in units of e. May be non-integral when an open shell is spherically averaged. Zero for a neutral species.

n_electrons.description: N, the electron count of the requested canonical configuration, formed by a compensated sum. Equals z - charge exactly.

occupation_nlq.description: [n, l, occupancy] of the ground configuration used by the SCF (spherically averaged; the Dirac solver splits l>0 into j = l+-1/2 in proportion to degeneracy).

numerics_config_tag.description: cache_tag of the NumericsConfig the atom was actually solved with (asserted equal to the recipe by gate G0).

bohr_A.description: Bohr radius in A used for K = 4 pi s a0 and for f_e [A] = a0 * f_e [a0]. Needed to reproduce the Mott-Bethe check from the file alone.

sha256_f64le.description: SHA-256 of the 7681 nodes as a float64 little-endian byte stream. A loader MUST reconstruct s_i = 6*i/7680 in binary64 (Julia 6.0*i/7680, Python 6*i/7680) and check this hash before interpolating.

enum: t_i = s_i^2 (non-uniform; do NOT replace by a uniform t grid); unique C^2 not-a-knot cubic in t at both ends through (t_i, f_e_i); evaluate at t = s^2 (route D)

DO NOT interpolate this array for a charged species: element 0 is null (f_e diverges as K^-2 at s = 0) and the array is provided for checking, not for evaluation. Interpolate f_e_regular_A instead, under the same rule the neutral f_e uses, and add the closed-form monopole: f_e(s) = monopole_coefficient_A_inv/s^2 + f_e_regular(s).
f_e_A.description: How f_e_A may be interpolated. Two texts are allowed and they are NOT interchangeable: the first applies to a neutral species, the second forbids interpolating the array for a charged species (element 0 is null) and points at f_e_regular_A instead.  (260912Cl: the v1-era `pattern` was dropped — it matched only the neutral wording, so every charged table failed it; the two-entry enum above is strictly stronger.)

f_x.description: X-ray atomic scattering factor [electrons] at s_i. f_x[0] == Z exactly (normalization is a wiring contract, see n_electrons_raw for the pre-normalization electron count). |f_x| <= Z.

f_e_A.description: First-Born (Mott-Bethe) NON-relativistic electron scattering factor [A] at s_i, gamma NOT included. Element 0 is null for a charged species (f_e diverges as K^-2 at s = 0) and a number for a neutral one. Values may be negative at low s for an anion, where the monopole 2q/K^2 dominates with q < 0. Consumers that need a finite forward value must use f_e_regular_A.

moments.description: Radial moments M_n = 4 pi int r^(2+n) rho dr [a0^n], normalization correction applied with the same rule as f_x. NOT <r^n> (that is M_n/N). Small-s expansion: f_e = a0[M2/3 - K^2 M4/60 + K^4 M6/2520 - K^6 M8/181440 + ...].

n_electrons_raw.description: Simpson integral of the SCF density BEFORE the uniform normalization (X3 quality indicator; expected Z*(1 - 6.5e-10) at dt/16).

norm_correction.description: Uniform scale minus 1 applied to f_x, the deficit and all moments.

gates.description: Generation-time gate ledger: every gate with value, threshold, rule and pass. A shipped file has pass == true everywhere (the generator refuses to write otherwise).  REQUIRED set is what both families emit; a charged species additionally carries the G6_* bound-subshell gates.

gates_version.description: Version of the gate ledger. v2 tables carry 2 (the G0 set became configuration / electron count / external field, and the G2 monopole gates and G3 truncation budget were added).

f_e_regular_A.description: Regular part of f_e [A] = 2 corr deficit(K) / K^2, finite and strictly positive at every node for every charge state, tending to a0 M2 / 3 as s -> 0. This is the quantity to interpolate (t = s^2, not-a-knot). It is constructed, never obtained by subtracting the monopole from f_e_A.

monopole_coefficient_A_inv.description: C [A^-1] in f_e_monopole(s) = C / s^2, equal to (Z - N) / (8 pi^2 a0). Exactly zero for a neutral species; same sign as charge otherwise. Closed form: it is deliberately not tabulated.

configuration_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical configuration byte string (temari-atom-config-v1). This, not charge, is what identifies the species.

species_tag.description: 16 hex digits appended to the file name for a charged species or one in an external field; the empty string for the neutral ground state, whose file name stays SF_Zxxx.json. Do not trust the file name: the identity is in configuration_sha256 and occupation_nlq.

external_field.description: Tag of the external one-body field used to stabilise the species, or 'none'. A multiply charged anion is not bound as a free ion, so it is solved inside a Watson sphere. WARNING: the stabilising field enters the SCF but is NOT part of the scattering source - the monopole coefficient stays (Z - N) / (8 pi^2 a0) and the field acts only through the density.

external_field_spec.description: Provenance of the external one-body field, or null when there is none. The tag in external_field cannot carry a citation, so the charge, the radius in both a0 and A, and the source string live here. The field enters the SCF only: it is not part of the scattering source, so the monopole coefficient stays (Z - N)/(8 pi^2 a0) and the field acts through the density alone.

model_uncertainty.description: Uncertainty from the choice of model rather than from numerics, or null when the species has no model knobs. For a species stabilised by an external field the shell charge Q and radius R are conventions taken from ionic-radius tables, and the low-s values depend on them far more than on any numerical tolerance; certified_domain_s_min_A_inv records which domain is to be certified, which is not a claim that certification has been run.

allOf.description: 260914 (review of step 4b): the requirements are tied to the dataset version, not to the table's own status claim. Every version except 0.0.0-dev and the legacy ion versions 0.1.0 to 0.4.0 (which predate these fields) must be computed / not_certified and carry the reason, the history and the record digest - including ion 1.0.0, neutral 2.0.0 (author decisions I40 / I45) and a later 0.x.y such as 0.5.0 (revised 260914 after the confirmation round: the exemption used to cover every 0.x.y).
260914: a development table (0.0.0-dev) written by the current generator is computed / not_a_shipping_species with a reason and the record digest.

From the 2026-09-14 generation onward (author decisions I35 / I36): a table whose certification_status is 'not_certified' is 'computed' and must carry the reason and the history of the earlier classification.
